seo.title: Bruna: AI-automated Meta sales (Advantage+) - 38% incremental purchases (2024)
seo.meta_description: With the agency Roas Hunter, Bruna measured that Meta Advantage+ generated 50% of its revenue and 38% incremental purchases over the wedding season in Spain, France, and Belgium.
seo.resume_citable: In 2024, the Spanish brand Bruna generated 50% of its revenue and 38% incremental purchases via Meta Advantage+ and the Conversions API, measured by Conversion Lift over the wedding season in Spain, France, and Belgium.

faq.q: Which Meta setup did Bruna use?
faq.a: Advantage+ Shopping for delivery, the Conversions API to make purchase measurement reliable on the server side, and Conversion Lift studies for incrementality.
The agency Roas Hunter, a Meta partner based in Valencia, with Bruna's e-commerce team.

pattern: AI-automated sales campaign plus Conversions API, measured incrementally by Conversion Lift, on a seasonal peak
objectif_business: Drive online sales during the wedding season, in a highly competitive sector, by measuring Meta's real contribution rather than attribution alone.
description: Bruna, the Spanish brand of customizable jewelry and accessories, handed its sales campaigns on Meta to Advantage+ Shopping mode, where the AI chooses audiences, placements, and creatives from the product catalog. The account was connected to the server-side Conversions API to make purchase reporting reliable, then measured with Conversion Lift studies over the high-demand wedding period in Spain, France, and Belgium. The work was carried out with the agency Roas Hunter, a Meta partner based in Valencia. On this setup, 50 percent of revenue was generated via Meta technologies, 38 percent of purchases were incremental, and 62 percent of add-to-cart events came from Meta technologies.
points_cles: AI-automated Meta sales campaigns (Advantage+ Shopping) over the wedding season.
Server-side Conversions API for measurement, incrementality via Conversion Lift, with the agency Roas Hunter.
50% of revenue via Meta, 38% incremental purchases, 62% of add-to-cart events.
Evidence level B, confirmed active status.

fonctionnement_operationnel.cadence: Continuous delivery, with a ramp-up on the seasonal wedding peak; incremental measurement in Conversion Lift waves.
fonctionnement_operationnel.opere_par: The agency Roas Hunter with Bruna's e-commerce team.
fonctionnement_operationnel.signal_pilote: The purchases and add-to-cart events reported by the server-side Conversions API. Without that server signal, the algorithm loses conversions blocked by the browser and optimizes less well.

etapes.detail: Server-side Conversions API so that each sale is reported even when the browser blocks tracking. This is the fuel for optimization.
Advantage+ Shopping chooses audiences, placements, and creatives from the catalog. The team provides feed and visuals.
Conversion Lift studies isolate the share truly generated by Meta during the wedding peak, to arbitrate the budget.

resultats.metrique: Share of revenue generated via Meta technologies
Share of incremental purchases attributed to Meta technologies
Share of add-to-cart events generated by Meta technologies

niveau_preuve.justification: Official Meta partner case study (Meta Business Partners), quantified, backed by the Conversions API and Conversion Lift studies, with founder and agency named; single source published by the platform and its partner.

stack_technique.detail: Meta's automated sales format: the AI chooses audiences, bids, placements, and creatives from the catalog feed.
Server-side reporting of purchases and add-to-cart events, so the algorithm optimizes even when the browser blocks tracking.
Incrementality studies with exposed / unexposed groups, used to isolate the share truly generated by Meta.
Meta partner media agency based in Valencia, which ran the setup with Bruna's e-commerce team.

prerequis_data: Server-side Conversions API with reliable purchases and add-to-cart events
Sufficient volume for Conversion Lift studies
prerequis_orga: A seasonal peak or a concentrated budget to arbitrate
Agreement to steer on incrementality rather than last click
stack_possible: Meta Advantage+ Sales Campaigns + CAPI (server-side GTM, Shopify or partner)
Conversion Lift or geo-test as the arbiter
replication.premiere_etape: Connect the server-side Conversions API then launch an Advantage+ Shopping campaign, and measure its incremental share via a Conversion Lift on the seasonal peak.

playbook.action: Connect the server-side Conversions API (server-side GTM, Shopify or partner) and check deduplication with the pixel.
playbook.livrable: Purchases and add-to-cart events reliably reported.

playbook.action: Clean the catalog feed: titles, images, prices, stock, and categories up to date.
playbook.livrable: Catalog validated in the Meta catalog manager.

playbook.action: Launch the Advantage+ Shopping campaign with the budget concentrated on the seasonal peak, without manual over-segmentation.
Let the algorithm optimize; monitor frequency, creative fatigue, and placement distribution.
Measure the incremental share via Conversion Lift (or geo-test) and arbitrate the budget on that basis rather than last click.
playbook.livrable: Incremental reading and budget decision documented.

replication.equipe: 1 Meta media buyer (in-house or agency) + 1 developer for the Conversions API.

statut_vivant.note: Bruna remains an active e-commerce merchant and Advantage+ Shopping is Meta's default sales format; the agency Roas Hunter remains a Meta partner, which ensures the durability of the pattern.

transposable_ue.note: Case already deployed in Spain, France, and Belgium, so in a GDPR/ePrivacy environment. Relies on the server-side Conversions API and Conversion Lift studies; activation subject to consent. Limited AI Act risk on the advertiser side.
